body.text:
zoekt-tngl-indexserver now subscribes to jetstream for `org.tangled.git.refs` and re-indexes a repo's default branch on each push, so it no longer waits for knotmirror to tell it about pushes. knotmirror's zoekt hook is removed.

The jetstream cursor only moves past a push once it is indexed, so a restart replays whatever was still queued. A failed index isn't retried; `/admin/enqueueIndex` stays as the knob for repos the stream missed.

Deploy zoekt before knotmirror.

title.text: zoekt-tngl-indexserver: index pushes from jetstream instead of knotmirror
